[[File:Goreu chathead.png|left]]
'''Goreu''' is one of the many citizens of [[Lletya]].

The player can only access Goreu to [[Thieving#Pickpocketing|pickpocket]] after starting [[Mourning's End Part I]] and require level 85 [[Thieving]]. A successful pickpocket yields [[coins]] or other items and 353.3 [[Thieving]] experience.

==Treasure Trails==
{{Anagram|Goreu|master|RUE GO}}. He will then give the player either a [[light box]] or a [[puzzle box]].
